t: The Mira Go White Electric Shower provides reliable and consistent hot water for daily showering needs. This powerful unit features pressure stabilised temperature control, ensuring a steady showering temperature even with fluctuating water pressure, which is ideal for busy family bathrooms or rental properties. Mira Clearscale technology actively reduces limescale build-up, maintaining performance and extending the appliance's life. With multiple cable and water entry points, installation is versatile for plumbers and electricians undertaking bathroom renovations. It includes separate controls for power and temperature, alongside an easy-to-use push-button start and rotary flow control.
b: Suitable for Cold Mains Water Only
